title: 3 Inch Cabinet Pull | Matte White | Solid Brass | Cabinet Hardware Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Refresh bathroom cabinetry with a small upgrade that makes doors and drawers easier to open and instantly more finished in Matte White, which brings clean, fresh simplicity that brightens spaces and creates a light, airy bathroom atmosphere. This 3 inch cabinet pull is part of a coordinated cabinet hardware collection designed to complement transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Coordinate the look: designed to pair with matching pieces in the Cabinet Hardware collection
- Built for lasting use: crafted from solid brass construction
- Install with confidence: mounting hardware is included
- Match your space: 

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 3.9 x 1.6 x 3 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 3 x 3 x 3 in.
- Shipping weight: 1 lb.
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
- Assembled in the USA
